newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 25.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
NEW YORK - NBC won its first primetime Nielsens premiere week in seven years -- though its solid gains were overshadowed by bigger dropoffs at ABC and Fox.
HOLLYWOOD - Fox has cancelled "Lush Life" and put "Party Girl" on hiatus, as neither Monday-night comedy caught fire in the ratings after three weeks on the air.
HOLLYWOOD - Macaulay Culkin will not be cast in "Home Alone III", the second sequel to the film that made him a star.
HOLLYWOOD - Turner Pictures will cultivate a remake of MGM's 1942 film "Random Harvest", with Robert Redford developing, starring in and possibly directing the pic, the company announced Tuesday.

HOLLYWOOD (Variety) - In a move that reflects the ever-worsening market for entertainment CD-ROMs, Viacom New Media which develops and publishes CD-based titles, is shuttering its New York operations.
